EN: The CAPS you spent will not be refunded. Are you sure?
ZH: 您所花费的瓶盖将无法返还。您确定要继续吗？

EN: Peace, strangers. Are we ever glad you showed up.
ZH: 祝你平安，陌生人。很高兴你能来。

EN: We set up this community to help people and bring them together.
ZH: 我们建立这个社区是为了帮助人们，让他们团结起来。

EN: Those raiders were just waiting for us to let our guard down.
ZH: 那些掠夺者就等着我们放松警惕。

EN: Thanks for your help. What can we do for you?
ZH: 谢谢你的帮助。我们能为你做什么？

EN: No. We've fought too hard to build this place. You'll have nothing.
ZH: 不，我们为建立这个地方付出了太多努力。你什么也得不到。

EN: We used to be in with the Brotherhood of Steel, but we're all more interested in helping people than things. So, how can we help each other?
ZH: 我们曾经属于钢铁兄弟会，但我们现在更关心帮助别人而不是收集东西。那么，我们该如何互相帮助呢？

EN: We'll take all the help we can get. You've got a deal.
ZH: 我们欢迎任何形式的帮助。一言为定。

EN: You can hand over your gear and supplies. We'll be taking everything.
ZH: 把你们的装备和物资交出来，都归我们了。

EN: Who are you? Why were you living with a bunch of raiders?
ZH: 你们是谁？为什么你们和一群掠夺者住在一起？

EN: We come from a vault nearby. Maybe we can look out for each other, trade supplies?
ZH: 我们来自附近的避难所。也许我们可以互相照顾，交易物资？
